bridge-type.label: WLED via JSON API
bridge-type.description: A connection to a WLED device controlled via the JSON API.

parameter.name: pollTime
parameter.label: Poll Time
parameter.description: Time in seconds of how often to fetch the state of the LEDs.

parameter.name: saturationThreshold
parameter.label: Saturation Threshold
parameter.description: This feature allows you to specify a number that if the saturation drops below, will trigger white.

parameter.name: sortEffects
parameter.label: Sort Effects
parameter.description: If set, will sort the state options of the effects channel alphabetically while keeping the first option (Solid) at the top.

parameter.name: sortPalettes
parameter.label: Sort Palettes
parameter.description: If set, will sort the state options of the palettes channel alphabetically while keeping the first option (Default) at the top.

thing-type.label: WLED Segment
thing-type.description: Controls an entire LED strip, or a section of the strip if the LED string is split into multiple segments.

parameter.name: segmentIndex
parameter.label: Segment Index
parameter.description: Leave this as 0 if you are not using multiple segments, otherwise set this to the segment index number that you wish to control.

channel-type.label: Global Brightness
channel-type.description: Allows you to fade and turn all segments ON and OFF at the same time

channel-type.label: Master Controls
channel-type.description: Allows you to exit FX mode and use the LEDS like a normal light

channel-type.label: Segment Brightness
channel-type.description: Changes the brightness of the whole segment

channel-type.label: Primary Color
channel-type.description: Allows you to change the primary color used in FX

channel-type.label: Primary White
channel-type.description: Changes the brightness of the primary white LED

channel-type.label: Secondary Color
channel-type.description: Allows you to change the secondary color used in FX

channel-type.label: Secondary White
channel-type.description: Changes the brightness of the secondary white LED

channel-type.label: Tertiary Color
channel-type.description: Allows you to change the third color used in FX

channel-type.label: Tertiary White
channel-type.description: Changes the brightness of the third white LED

channel-type.label: Palettes
channel-type.description: Change the colours used by the FX

channel-type.label: Effect
channel-type.description: Use the built in FX

channel-type.label: Presets
channel-type.description: Auto rotate or change to a saved preset

channel-type.label: Playlists
channel-type.description: The currently playing play list

channel-type.label: Preset Duration
channel-type.description: Time for how long to show each preset for before moving to the next

channel-type.label: Grouping
channel-type.description: How many consecutive LEDs of the same segment will be grouped to the same color

channel-type.label: Spacing
channel-type.description: How many LEDs are turned off and skipped between each group

channel-type.label: Live Override
channel-type.description: Live data override. 0 is off, 1 is override until live data ends, 2 is override until ESP reboot

channel-type.label: Transform Time
channel-type.description: Time it takes to change/fade from one look to the next.

channel-type.label: FX Speed
channel-type.description: Change the speed of the FX

channel-type.label: FX Intensity
channel-type.description: Change the intensity of the FX

channel-type.label: Mirror Effect
channel-type.description: Mirror the effect for this segment

channel-type.label: Reverse Direction
channel-type.description: Reverse the direction of the current segment

channel-type.label: Sleep Timer
channel-type.description: Fade the level of light and turn off after set time

channel-type.label: Sleep Mode
channel-type.description: Timed Light Mode selects how the light will fade or increase when the sleep timer is turned ON.

channel-type.label: Sleep Duration
channel-type.description: Time it takes to change/fade to the target brightness.

channel-type.label: Sleep Target Brightness
channel-type.description: Sets how bright the light will be after the sleep duration time has expired.

channel-type.label: Preset Cycle
channel-type.description: Cycle through the saved presets

channel-type.label: Sync Send
channel-type.description: Sends UDP packets that tell other WLED lights to follow this one.

channel-type.label: Sync Receive
channel-type.description: Allows UDP packets from other WLED lights to control this one.

channel-type.label: Sleep Remaining
channel-type.description: Time that is left until the sleep timer has finished, 0 when the sleep timer is not running.

channel-type.label: Uptime
channel-type.description: How long the WLED device has been running since it was last started. Needs firmware 0.14.0 or newer.

channel-type.label: Free Heap
channel-type.description: Free memory of the WLED device. Needs firmware 0.14.0 or newer.

channel-type.label: Wi-Fi Signal
channel-type.description: Quality of the Wi-Fi signal that the WLED device receives. Needs firmware 0.14.0 or newer.

channel-type.label: Estimated Current
channel-type.description: The current that WLED estimates the LEDs are using. Needs firmware 0.14.0 or newer.

channel-type.label: Frames per Second
channel-type.description: How many frames per second the WLED device is currently showing. Needs firmware 0.14.0 or newer.

channel-type.label: White Temperature
channel-type.description: Changes the white spectrum from warm (0%) to cold (100%). Only for LED strips that have CCT support.

channel-type.label: FX Slider 1
channel-type.description: First custom slider of the effect. What it does depends on the selected effect. Needs firmware 0.14.0 or newer.

channel-type.label: FX Slider 2
channel-type.description: Second custom slider of the effect. What it does depends on the selected effect. Needs firmware 0.14.0 or newer.

channel-type.label: FX Slider 3
channel-type.description: Third custom slider of the effect, it has 32 steps. What it does depends on the selected effect. Needs firmware 0.14.0 or newer.

channel-type.label: FX Option 1
channel-type.description: First option of the effect. What it does depends on the selected effect. Needs firmware 0.14.0 or newer.

channel-type.label: FX Option 2
channel-type.description: Second option of the effect. What it does depends on the selected effect. Needs firmware 0.14.0 or newer.

channel-type.label: FX Option 3
channel-type.description: Third option of the effect. What it does depends on the selected effect. Needs firmware 0.14.0 or newer.

channel-type.label: Freeze
channel-type.description: Freezes the effect of this segment on the current frame. Needs firmware 0.14.0 or newer.

channel-type.label: Selected
channel-type.description: Segments that are selected receive the commands that are sent without a segment, like with the WLED app.

channel-type.label: Segment Start
channel-type.description: The first LED of this segment, counting starts at 0.

channel-type.label: Segment Stop
channel-type.description: The first LED after the end of this segment, so it is not part of the segment.

channel-type.label: Segment Name
channel-type.description: The name of this segment. Needs firmware 0.13.0 or newer.

channel-type.label: Sync Send Groups
channel-type.description: The groups that this light sends its changes to as a bit mask, group 1 is 1, group 2 is 2, group 3 is 4 up to group 8 that is 128.

channel-type.label: Sync Receive Groups
channel-type.description: The groups that this light listens to as a bit mask, group 1 is 1, group 2 is 2, group 3 is 4 up to group 8 that is 128.

channel-type.label: Main Segment
channel-type.description: The number of the main segment, it is used by the web page and the apps of WLED.

channel-type.label: LED Map
channel-type.description: Loads the LED map with this number, 0 is the ledmap.json and 1 to 9 are ledmap1.json to ledmap9.json. The device does not report the active map, so this channel only sends. Needs firmware 0.14.0 or newer.

channel-type.label: Live Data Active
channel-type.description: ON when another device or app is sending live data to the lights, like a DDP, E1.31 or Art-Net stream.

channel-type.label: Live Data Mode
channel-type.description: The protocol of the live data that the lights show.

channel-type.label: Live Data Source
channel-type.description: The IP address that sends the live data.

channel-type.label: Audio Reactive
channel-type.description: Turns the AudioReactive usermod on or off. Needs a WLED version with the AudioReactive usermod.

channel-type.label: Audio Sync Mode
channel-type.description: Sends the audio of this device to other WLED devices, or receives the audio from another one. Needs the AudioReactive usermod.

channel-type.label: Mapping
channel-type.description: How the effect is mapped on a 2D matrix. Needs firmware 0.14.0 or newer.

channel-type.label: Sound Simulation
channel-type.description: The simulated sound that sound reactive effects use when no audio is received. Needs firmware 0.14.0 or newer.
